title: PANO: Parallel Latent Space Neural Operator for Solving PDEs
abstract: arXiv:2611.22782v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Aggregating observations into a limited number of latent tokens and learning physical interactions in the latent space has emerged as an effective approach for Transformer-based neural operators to solve Partial Differential Equation (PDE) problems involving large-scale observations. However, existing methods typically compress observations using a single aggregation pattern, making physical information not retained by that pattern invisible to the latent space and thereby constraining physical interactions within it. To address this limitation, we propose PArallel Latent Space Neural Operator (PANO), a novel neural operator for solving PDEs that formulates physical interactions among observations as an additive combination of interaction results from parallel latent spaces with shared parameters. translated_title: PANO：用于求解偏微分方程的并行潜空间神经算子
translated_abstract: 将观测数据聚合到有限数量的潜空间标记中，并在潜空间中学习物理交互，已成为基于Transformer的神经算子求解涉及大规模观测的偏微分方程（PDE）问题的有效方法。然而，现有方法通常使用单一聚合模式来压缩观测数据，使得该模式未能保留的物理信息对潜空间不可见，从而限制了潜空间内的物理交互。为了解决这一局限，我们提出了并行潜空间神经算子，这是一种用于求解PDE的新型神经算子，它将观测数据之间的物理交互表述为具有共享参数的多个并行潜空间交互结果的相加组合。具体而言，PANO通过独立映射将观测数据转换为多个不同的压缩表示，并学习物理交互。
tldr: 提出并行潜空间神经算子PANO，通过多个共享参数的并行潜空间将观测数据压缩为多种不同表示，并将各空间的交互结果相加组合，克服了现有方法单一聚合模式导致物理信息不可见的局限，更全面地学习偏微分方程求解中的物理交互。
en_tdlr: PANO is a novel neural operator that formulates physical interactions among observations as an additive combination of interaction results from parallel latent spaces with shared parameters, overcoming the limitation of single aggregation patterns that make unretained physical information invisible to the latent space in Transformer-based PDE solvers.
